root.html: <section style="font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.75; color: {{text}}; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-align: justify; margin: 0 8px 24px">{{content}}</section>

heading.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.75; font-weight: 700; color: {{heading}}; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-align: justify; margin: 0 8px 24px">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading3.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.75; font-weight: 700; color: {{text}}; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-align: justify; margin: 32px 8px 24px">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

paragraph.html: {{content}}

inlineCode.html: {{content}}

code.html: {{content}}

quote.html: {{content}}

listItem.html: • {{content}}

table.html: {{thead}}{{tbody}}

tableHead.html: <th style="font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.55; font-weight: 700; color: #94452F; background: {{surface}}; padding: 10px 8px; text-align: left; vertical-align: middle; border-bottom: 1px solid #EBCDBE; border-right: 1px solid #EBCDBE; overflow-wrap: anywhere">{{content}}</th>

tableCell.html: {{content}}

divider.html: <hr style="border: 0; border-top: 1px solid #F0DED5; margin: 40px auto 18px; width: 36%" />
